known_limitations: Raw Riskfolio CVaR weights before score tilt are not saved in V5.16 outputs.
Exact score-tilt multipliers are not saved in V5.16 outputs.
Exact pre-cash, post-cash, pre-turnover, and post-turnover ticker-level attribution is not saved in V5.16 outputs.

final_holdings.PlainEnglishExplanation: SGOV is the cash/T-bill sleeve. The model uses it when it does not want the full portfolio in risk ETFs, usually because market breadth is weaker or the selected ETF basket is too volatile.

AVUV received an allocation because it passed the latest ETF selection process, survived the diversification/correlation filter, and then received a weight from CVaR risk sizing plus the score tilt. Main positives: above medium-term trend, above longer-term trend, positive 3-month momentum, positive 6-month momentum. Saved model note: Current eligible ETF selected by the V5.7/V5.9b signal layer.

EIS is likely a carryover holding. It may remain because V5.16 limits monthly turnover, so the portfolio does not fully replace old positions in one rebalance. Main positives: positive 6-month momentum. Saved model note: Carryover/kept holding from prior rebalance; still above pruning threshold.
